notes: The city layer provides a direct apartment-structure filter, owner/applicant/contractor names, valuation, and sometimes NumberofUnits. When NumberofUnits is blank, the runner may parse an explicit unit count from WorkDescription; it never estimates one.
freshness_note: Stale at the source, not a runner fault. Before touching the runner, confirm freshness with outStatistics max(DateIssued) on the layer; if it moves past 2025-01-16 the city has resumed publishing and this recipe starts producing leads again with no code change.
